Title: Stand-in Adventurer's Weapons (Glass release)
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the Glass release's folder name and the shape of
the scripts it uses (the hl2 ammo system's item fields, v20's spread onFire,
a raycast support script's image fields, projectile headshot multipliers and
a taser that tumbles), so the listed port applies to it. It is not the
original Add-On and holds none of its files, and its numbers are its own.
